html:
SMTO-WEB-0058 — SMTO's main model can't look at pictures of this page

GUID: 1648ab84-4b26-5f94-8eb4-980eb5317b2f
Slug: research-visual-semantics-unavailable
Domain: WEB · Subsystem: web_research

What happened

  • SMTO turned a document page into a picture, but the main model it uses can only read text, not pictures. Anything shown only in diagrams or charts on that page can't be confirmed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO to answer using only the written text in the document, and to tell you which parts it couldn't check. The main model can read the text but can't look at the picture of the page, so text-based answers stay accurate.
  2. If the answer depends on a chart or diagram, type out the labels or values you need, or share another source that describes them in words. Written details let SMTO confirm what the picture shows without needing to see it.
  3. If you manage SMTO, open Settings › Setup › Model routing and, if you have one available, set Main to a model that can read images. Only a Main model that is set up to accept images can look at pictures of pages itself.

What success looks like

  • SMTO's answer is based on the document's text or the details you gave, and it clearly says if any picture-only parts remain unchecked.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO's model settings. Don't rely on any part of the answer that describes a diagram unless SMTO says it confirmed it.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Retained catalog alias for unavailable visual semantics: a PDF page was rendered to an image but the primary model lacks image input, so diagram or layout content on that page cannot be verified (recorded as visual_semantics_unresolved).

What this means

  • This retained alias refers to unavailable visual semantics; current PDF observation records visual_semantics_unresolved when a rendered page exists but the primary model lacks image input. This retained catalog alias has no direct current emitting site. The related runtime behavior supplies context only; the alias alone does not establish that the check ran, publication was blocked, or a model call failed.

Why this can happen

  • This retained alias refers to unavailable visual semantics; current PDF observation records visual_semantics_unresolved when a rendered page exists but the primary model lacks image input.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect primary-model image support and distinguish rendered artifacts from actual visual observations.

How to fix it

  • This alias has no current direct emitter; on PDF render (skills/web_research/runtime.py observe) research.visual_semantics_unresolved is set when the primary client's model_capabilities.image_input is not true. Rely on embedded text, explicit OCR, textual corroboration or a scoped limitation, or configure a Main model whose endpoint reports image input in Settings › Setup › Model routing. Its presence alone does not establish that a check ran, an answer was blocked or a model call failed.
  • Use embedded text, explicit OCR for labels, textual corroboration or a scoped limitation. Rendering alone does not establish vision.

Retry and execution caution

  • Use verified facts or an explicit scoped limitation.

How to verify the fix

  • Claims rely on supported text, explicit OCR or actual image understanding, with remaining visual limits disclosed.

What not to do

  • Do not claim that the primary model inspected visual page content when that capability is unavailable.

Technical notes

  • This retained catalog alias has no direct current emitting site. The related runtime behavior supplies context only; the alias alone does not establish that the check ran, publication was blocked, or a model call failed.
